messages:
Priya: Quick recap from today's renewal check-in with AstraCart: they want to expand Redwood to Merchandising + CX + Fraud teams. Main asks: predictable p95 under 400ms for short summarization calls, support for bulk transcript ingestion, and a Private/VPC option because of customer PII. They also asked for a rough committed capacity quote.

Tom: Nice. Do we have their current usage profile? token/day, qps, embedding batch sizes?

Priya: Their analytics show ~120k tokens/day today, mostly embeddings for search and short summaries. They expect 8x QPS when Merchandising goes live. Bulk uploads are nightly batches of ~2-3M tokens.

Daniel: 8x is substantial. Recommend proposing a 3-week Dedicated pilot (reserved pool + burst) and a Private eval for the Fraud team only. That way we separate PII workloads.

Mei: For the Private option we'll need to check VPC peering and KMS/HSM integration. I'll start the security intake. Also, for cost modeling we should provide token-based projection and a per-hour reserved node cost so CFO has something concrete.

Priya: They want a demo showing p50/p95 for short summaries and cost per 1k tokens at projected load. Also asked about fallback behavior if Dedicated saturates.

Tom: Fallback plan: route to a cheaper model variant in a lower tier with graceful degradation + alerting. We'll show latency tradeoffs and expected quality delta.

Daniel: Technical plan: 1) collect sample prompts + one week of prod traces; 2) run perf sweep with both short summarization (<=256 tokens) and long batch ingestion flows; 3) enable prefix/KV cache for transcripts ingestion; 4) create Dedicated config preview (pool size, burst policy, autoscale window).

Mei: I'll capture the infra checklist: VPC setup, subnets, NAT, KMS key, audit log retention, and SOC control questionnaire.

Priya: I'll propose a pilot scope doc to AstraCart: target teams, SLOs (p95 < 400ms), data isolation for Fraud, and three-week timeline. Planning to align renewal discount with a signed pilot commitment.

Tom: Timeline note: need perf numbers + cost sheet before the pilot pitch. Daniel, can you run a cost forecast assuming 8x and a 4-node dedicated pool?

Daniel: Yep. I'll run cost sim and include token/unit and node-hour breakdown. ETA 72h.

infra-bot: Ticket created: CS-4678 AstraCart Expansion Pilot  https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4678

Priya: Scheduling: proposing an enablement + security sync Wed 9am PT next week. Will invite Merchandising lead, CX PM, and Fraud eng lead. Everyone good?

Tom: +1

Daniel: +1

Mei: +1

Priya: Great. I'll upload sample prompts and a redacted trace dump to the shared enablement folder by EOD. Also capturing their ask for private deployment pricing separately.

Tom: Note for renewal team: flag as "opportunity to expand with pilot" and include renewal risk if we can't meet p95/cost expectations. Priya, can you add a short note to the renewal play?

Priya: On it. Adding to renewal doc now and tagging finance for input on pilot discounting.
